title.narrative: Support to the EU Information Centers Network in Turkey

description.narrative: The service contract in question foresees the management of an EU Information Centres Network in Turkey. This Network will assist to organize local public diplomacy events and disseminate information on EU priority topics. The EU Info Centres serve as a gateway for the public to reach out to the European Union. This network is also a major tool for the EU Delegation to reach the vast population in Turkey that consists of different ethnic groups, geographical background, political orientations and different degrees of inclinations towards religion.
